observations: The complete active formula has no test block. Build-time make check does not exercise the installed library. No source or build evidence supports dependency or platform findings.

findings.reason: The complete formula has no test block. Running upstream checks during installation does not verify that consumers can compile, link, and exercise the installed websocket library.
findings.verification: Add a functional formula test that compiles and links a small C program against the installed wslay library and asserts meaningful API behavior, then run brew test wslay on an appropriate Homebrew machine.
